title: Southside Bancshares, Inc. Declares Cash Dividend
summary: TYLER, Texas, Feb. 05, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - The Board of Directors of Southside Bancshares, Inc., (NYSE:SBSI), parent company of Southside Bank declared a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.36 per common share. The cash dividend of $0.36 is scheduled for payment on March 5, 2026, to common stock shareholders of record on February 19, 2026. About Southside Bancshares, Inc. Southside Bancshares, Inc. is a bank holding company headquartered in Tyler, Texas, with approximately $8.51 billion in assets as of December 31, 2025, that wholly-owns Southside Bank. Southside Bank currently operates 53 branches and a network of 70 ATMs/ITMs throughout East Texas, Southeast Texas and the greater Dallas/Fort Worth, Austin and Houston areas. Serving customers since 1960, Southside Bank is a community-focused financial institution that offers a full range of financial products and services to individuals and businesses.
